query: Please implement a function to dynamically update the SEO title based on the query parameter string in the URL. The user should be able to input or modify the query parameters in the URL, and the website should automatically update the SEO title to reflect the new query parameters. The website should be able to parse the query parameters from the URL and integrate them into the SEO title, ensuring that the title accurately reflects the content of the current page. Set the background color to turquoise and the component color to cadet blue.
